frames.name: Foundations · Colour · Dark
frames.description: Variable-bound swatches for the explicitly pinned frame mode. Foregrounds use their own paired surfaces; decorative-border and status-strip ratios are informational. Displayed values and ratios are generated static text, not live calculations. Mode: dark.

frames.name: Foundations · Type · Dark
frames.description: Two families: Poppins for UI, Roboto Mono for code and numerals. Samples below are live text at the token’s real size and weight, so this frame is a specimen, not a table of numbers. Role aliases at the bottom record the usage vocabulary inherited from Collider-Old. Mode: dark.

frames.name: Foundations · Space & Shape · Dark
frames.description: Raw scales first, usage-named aliases second — the hybrid model set in Phase 1b. New components pick from the scale; the alias blocks record the vocabulary that formalised atoms already use. Bars and boxes below are drawn at their real value. Mode: dark.

frames.name: Foundations · Elevation · Dark
frames.description: CSS drop-shadow specimens derived from each selected mode, not bindable effect variables. Symmetric padding preserves the full effect reach. Rebuild after token changes; light-mode tuning remains a design question, not an automatic pass. Mode: dark.

frames.name: Foundations · Motion · Dark
frames.description: Duration bars use the actual duration values at 1ms = 1px. Easing strings and each role's duration/easing pair are recorded as values; this is not an animation preview. Mode: dark.

frames.name: Foundations · Layout · Dark
frames.description: Container bars use a labeled 60% display scale; gutter specimens retain actual token widths. These represent app layout constraints, not documentation frame geometry. Mode: dark.
